title: Discover, Explain, Improve: An Automatic Slice Detection Benchmark for Natural Language Processing
reasoning: The paper includes religious identity markers as a core component of its benchmarking and evaluation framework. Specifically, it utilizes the 'Jigsaw-religion' dataset and identifies 'religion' as a pragmatic feature to evaluate how slice detection models identify error-prone groups associated with religious identities such as Atheist, Buddhist, Christian, Hindu, Jewish, and Muslim.
